topic: Small stable 2.1.0 support cut and deferral
recommended: Approve a scoped stable core after CORE-001/002 dependency/compatibility review; retain unfinished modern native, modules, broader data, expert and product/research work as separately labeled future work
benefits: Preserves later scientific work without claiming it complete
costs: 2.1.0 will support less than the entire current research candidate
Requires a precise artifact/import/claim boundary and some author review
alternative: Keep all original seven groups as all-at-once GA prerequisites
alternative_cost: Stronger single comprehensive milestone but continued serialization and delayed release
approval_effect: Only an explicit recorded scope amendment can replace the applicable original GA checklist; inventory is not final semantic acceptance

recommended: Keep identity/meaning in the core; place country/source/application completeness, cardinality and database restrictions in named opt-in profiles unless globally justified
benefits: Global extension and sparse data remain usable
RDB/SHACL implementation needs do not accidentally become universal axioms
costs: Profile selection and validation must be explicit
Some applications need a stricter local schema
alternative: Apply one strict global implementation schema to all use cases
alternative_cost: Fewer profile choices but unsupported global restrictions and poor reuse
approval_effect: The user authorized the design direction, not blanket deletion/weakening of current axioms; review each actual semantic delta

topic: Reuse license for assets with confirmed rights
recommended: After rights inventory: CC BY 4.0 for owned ontology/docs and MIT for owned software; preserve external data/software terms and notices
benefits: Clear international reuse and modification route
Attribution for research artifacts and permissive code reuse
costs: Rights holders and asset boundaries need confirmation
Third-party content cannot be covered by an invented blanket grant
alternative: Retain existing per-asset notices while finalizing ownership
alternative_cost: Current publication can retain its limits, but broad reuse permissions remain unclear
approval_effect: No root LICENSE or asset relicense is applied by this proposal; confirm authority before adopting any grant

recommended: Retain the named positive-lower shared-ATarget profile, unchanged archived channel and visible optional-example discrepancy
benefits: Avoids silently declaring a zero-lower association invalid or rewriting official history
costs: The optional BugTracker example remains a recorded interpretation tension
Acceptance is only for this bounded profile, not the full model
alternative: Revise the semantic profile to include the optional case after explicit new-source adjudication
alternative_cost: Needs a new named/versioned oracle and boundary tests; cannot rewrite old outcomes
approval_effect: An actual ACCEPT/REVISE/DEFER response with rationale closes only this card; it neither approves the other three policies nor the full ontology
